question.text: What is the collective net long position limit for Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) in Exchange Traded Interest Rate Futures (IRF)?

answer.text: There is no position limit for FPIs in IRF

explanation.text: The Logic: The INR 50 billion (Rs 5,000 crore) limit specified in the source applies to FPIs collectively for taking net long IRF positions in Exchange Traded Interest Rate Futures. The Trap: This figure is not the position limit for scheduled commercial banks; for banks and primary dealers, the SEBI ETIRD position-limit table uses category limits such as 10 percent of open interest or INR 1,200 crore for the 8–11 year bucket, whichever is higher. Note: When answering position-limit questions in IRF, identify the participant category first (FPI collective vs bank/institutional client) before selecting a numerical limit.
